author: xhigh
claim: The exact admissibility characterization was stress-tested at every cancellation locus and was not refuted.
evidence: If y=-1, the recurrence at n=1 forces x a_3=0 and hence a_3=0 because x is nonzero. If y!=-1 but x+y+1=0, the derived formula a_4=(x+y+1)/(xy) forces a_4=0. If y!=-1 and x+y+1!=0 but x=-1, the derived formula a_5=(x+1)/y forces a_5=0. These exhaust the failures of the three inequalities in first-failure order. Off all three loci, the explicit five terms are nonzero and return to the initial pair, so there is no further hidden failure locus.

links.target_claim: The three displayed inequalities are necessary and sufficient for an infinite sequence.
links.candidate_counterexample: An initial pair off the three exceptional lines whose orbit later reaches zero.
assumptions_satisfied: x and y are nonzero residues
all three exceptional equalities are audited in first-failure order
links.failed_conclusion: No failure: the five-step return precludes a later first zero.
links.impact: The line-complement count has no omitted boundary stratum.

glossary.F_p: the field of residues modulo the fixed prime p
glossary.x: the nonzero residue class of a_1
